summary: Tested Compresión Geométrica (MOCG codec) feature end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases passed including round-trip lossless (comprimir → paquete → descomprimir with sha256_ok=true for all files) and system compression for hotel domain (n_events_total=13, file_types includes 'jsonlines'). Frontend /archivos route: header 'ARCHIVOS · EMBUDO' renders, file input + both buttons (procesar-embudo-btn, comprimir-btn) present with data-testids. Selecting 2 files (jsonl + csv) and clicking comprimir-btn triggered download of paquete.mocg.json and rendered shape-report with metrics (22 events, 100% en la forma, 3 entidades, ratio 0.28x, 2 archivos). Embudo button returns expected clear error 'Sistema no configurado' via backend /api/expedientes (403/400) — confirmed via curl.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>1700 lines). Consider splitting into routers per feature (compresion, aprendiz, bimestral, ingesta) for maintainability.
Compression ratio of 0.28x for tiny inputs is expected (base64+JSON overhead) but users may misinterpret. Consider labeling as 'tamaño relativo' or omitting for small inputs.
compresion_geometrica.IncrementalManifold access via `manifold._entities` from server code is fine internally, but expose a public accessor for cleanliness.
seed_data_creation: None; used /app/backend/aprendiz_data/hotel_learning_log.jsonl (pre-existing) for the sistema/hotel test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 'Compresión Geométrica' verified. Endpoints /api/compresion/toggle (comprimir + descomprimir round-trip lossless) and /api/compresion/sistema/{dominio} both work. Frontend /archivos route works. Note: file-input has className='hidden' by design (label wraps it) — Playwright's set_input_files works fine but is_visible() returns False; do NOT wait_for_selector as visible on that input, use query_selector.
